modules.title: Introduction to C Programming
modules.goal: Program ka idea, C ka itihaas aur pehla C program compile karke chalana.
prereqs: Programming ka koi experience zaroori nahi
modules.definition: C ek compiled, statically typed, procedural language hai jo 1972 me Dennis Ritchie ne Bell Labs me banayi. Aaj bhi OS, embedded devices aur databases ki backbone hai.
explain: Program instructions ki list hai: input lo, memory me rakho, calculate karo, output do. C me ye instructions .c text file me likhi jaati hain.
Compiler us text ko machine code me badalta hai, isliye C fast hai aur errors chalne se pehle milte hain — Python jaisi interpreter language me nahi.
C chhoti hai (C17 me 32 keywords) aur garbage collector nahi hai: memory aap manage karte ho. Isi discipline se OS aur drivers likhe jaate hain.
modules.analogy: C building ka raw material hai (eent, cement, sariya); Python ready-made furniture. Raw material se ghar banana mushkil hai, par jo banaoge wahi tikta hai — aur C seekhne ke baad baaki languages ke andar ka engine samajh aata hai.
modules.why: Pointers, memory aur performance ka asli model C se aata hai. Interviews ke pointers/segfault sawaal yahin se aate hain, aur Linux, SQLite, Redis ka source C me hai.

modules.title: C Development Environment
modules.goal: GCC toolchain chalana, compile flags samajhna, compile aur linker errors padh kar fix karna.
modules.definition: Development environment wo toolchain hai jo source ko executable banata hai: editor (VS Code), compiler (GCC/Clang), assembler, linker, debugger (GDB) aur build automation (Make).
explain: C khud kuch nahi chalata — compiler chahiye. Linux/macOS par GCC/Clang; Windows par MSYS2/MinGW-w64 ya WSL sabse aasan rasta hai.
VS Code sirf editor hai, compiler nahi. C/C++ extension IntelliSense aur debug UI deta hai; asli compile gcc command karti hai.
gcc hello.c -o hello ka matlab: compile karo aur output ka naam hello rakho. -std=c17 standard fix karta hai, -Wall -Wextra warnings on karte hain.
Error me pehla line sabse important hota hai — baad ke errors often usi ke consequence hote hain. Line number aur column dhyan se dekho.
modules.analogy: Compiler translator hai: aap C me likhte ho, machine apni bhasha samajhti hai. Grammar galat hui to translator line number ke saath reject karta hai.
modules.why: Beginners ka 90% time environment me jaata hai: gcc nahi mila, file save nahi hui, path galat. Ye module us friction ko khatam karta hai.

modules.title: Variables and Data Types
modules.goal: Har C data type, sizeof, scope/lifetime, storage classes, conversion aur overflow ko practically samajhna.
prereqs: Module 1-2: program likhna aur compile karna
modules.definition: Variable memory ka named location hai jiska type batata hai kitni bytes chahiye aur unhe kaise interpret karna hai. C ke fundamental types char, int, float, double aur void hain; unke short/long/signed/unsigned variants derived aur user-defined types ke saath milte hain.
explain: C statically typed hai: type compile time par fix hota hai aur variable ka size bhi. int typically 4 bytes, char 1 byte, double 8 bytes — exact size platform par depend karta hai, isliye sizeof use karo.
Declaration memory reserve karti hai, initialization pehli value deti hai. Local variable uninitialized ho to uska value indeterminate hota hai — padhna undefined behaviour hai.
Scope batata hai naam kahan dikhega; lifetime batata hai memory kab tak zinda rahegi. Local block ke andar, global poore file me, static lifetime program ke end tak.
Type conversion implicit (compiler) ya explicit (cast) hoti hai. Chhoti type me bada value daalne par truncation hota hai; signed overflow undefined behaviour hai — unsigned wrap karta hai.
modules.analogy: Variable ek dabba hai jiska label naam hai aur shape type. int ka dabba 4-byte ka hai, char ka 1-byte. Galat shape me zyada saaman thoosoge to overflow ho jaayega.
modules.why: 90% C bugs type ke galat assumption se aate hain: int overflow, float precision, unsigned underflow, uninitialized read. Inhe samajhna pointers aur memory ka base hai.

syntax.note: Suffixes: u unsigned, L long, LL long long, f float.
sizeof size_t deta hai, isliye %zu. limits.h me har type ki limits hain.
Cast intention clear karta hai; unsigned wrap defined hai, signed overflow nahi.

topics.title: Scope, lifetime, storage classes
topics.body: auto (default local, block lifetime), static (local: lifetime poore program ki, value retain; file-scope: internal linkage), extern (definition kahin aur hai), register (compiler ko hint, address nahi le sakte). Global variables zero-initialized hoti hain, locals nahi.

topics.title: Conversion, overflow, precision
topics.body: Integer promotion chhote types ko int me badalti hai. Float→int truncate karta hai. Signed overflow UB hai (compiler optimize kar sakta hai). 0.1 + 0.2 == 0.3 false hota hai — binary floating point exact nahi hai. const/volatile/restrict qualifiers intent batate hain.

modules.title: Input and Output
modules.goal: printf/scanf family, format specifiers, string input aur input validation ko safely use karna.
modules.definition: C me standard I/O streams (stdin, stdout, stderr) ke through hota hai. printf formatted output deta hai; scanf formatted input padhta hai; getchar/putchar characters; fgets line-based safe string input deta hai.
explain: printf format string + arguments leta hai. Har % specifier batata hai value kaise print karni hai: %d int, %f double, %c char, %s string, %p pointer, %zu size_t.
scanf ko address chahiye, value nahi — isliye & lagta hai: scanf("%d", &age). String (char array) me & ki zaroorat nahi kyunki array khud address me decay hota hai.
scanf whitespace par rukta hai, isliye spaces wala naam %s se poora nahi padha jaata. Line padhne ke liye fgets(buffer, size, stdin) use karo — buffer overflow se bachne ka safe rasta.
Mixed scanf aur fgets me leftover newline bug aata hai: scanf ke baad buffer me \n bacha rehta hai. getchar() se consume karo ya poora line-based input lo.
Production input par kabhi bharosa mat karo: return value check karo (scanf kitne items padhe), range validate karo, aur fgets ke baad newline trim karo.
modules.analogy: printf ek printer hai jo format template ke hisaab se values bharta hai. scanf ek form hai jisme aapko batane padta hai value kahan likhni hai — isliye address (&) dena padta hai, warna form kahin aur bhar jaayega (crash).
modules.why: User input hi real programs ka pehla attack surface hai. Galat format specifier UB deta hai, unbounded %s buffer overflow — security bug. Sahi I/O likhna aage ke saare interactive programs ki neenv hai.

syntax.note: printf me double ke liye %f (ya %lf, same), scanf me double ke liye %lf zaroori.
Return value check karo; fgets newline chhodta hai, trim karo.
Left/right align, zero pad, sign, hex — width aur flags.

modules.title: Operators and Expressions
modules.goal: Arithmetic se bitwise tak har operator, precedence/associativity aur short-circuit evaluation ko samajhna.
modules.definition: Operator ek symbol hai jo operands par operation karta hai aur expression banata hai. C me arithmetic, relational, logical, assignment, increment/decrement, bitwise, conditional, comma aur sizeof operators hain.
explain: Arithmetic (+ - * / %) integer operands par integer division karta hai: 7/2 = 3. % sirf integers par chalta hai aur negative numbers par sign dividend ka hota hai (-7 % 3 = -1).
Relational (< > <= >= == !=) 0 ya 1 dete hain. Assignment = aur comparison == alag hain — if (x = 5) hamesha true hota hai, compiler warning deta hai.
Logical && aur || short-circuit karte hain: agar left side se answer pata chal gaya to right side evaluate hi nahi hota. Isliye p && p->next safe hai.
Bitwise (& | ^ ~ << >>) bits par kaam karte hain — flags, masks, fast multiply/divide. Right shift signed negative par implementation-defined hai; unsigned par zero-fill.
Increment/decrement me prefix (++i: pehle badhao) aur postfix (i++: pehle use karo) ka fark hai. Ek hi expression me variable ko do baar modify karna UB hai.
modules.analogy: Expression ek kitchen recipe hai jisme operations ka order fixed hai — pehle brackets, phir multiply, phir add. Precedence wahi order hai; associativity batati hai same level par left ya right se chalo.
modules.why: Kisi bhi language ka logic yahin banta hai: conditions, loops, masks aur flags. Precedence ki galti se silently galat result aata hai — jo crash se zyada khatarnak hai.

syntax.note: Integer division truncate karta hai; cast se float division.

syntax.code:
int flags = 0b1010;      /* C23; C17 me 0xA */
flags |= 0x1;            /* set bit 0 */
flags &= ~0x2;           /* clear bit 1 */
if (flags & 0x8) { }     /* test bit 3 */
printf("%d\n", flags << 1);
syntax.note: Set/clear/test/shift — bitmask ka core.
Postfix/prefix aur comma operator.

topics.title: Arithmetic aur modulus
topics.body: + - * / %; integer division truncate karti hai. % integers ke liye, sign dividend ka. Overflow signed par UB, unsigned par wrap. Division/modulus by zero UB hai — check karo.

topics.title: Relational aur logical
topics.body: == != < <= > >= 0/1 dete hain. && || ! short-circuit karte hain, precedence: ! > && > ||. if (a == b) aur if (!strcmp(a,b)) ke semantics alag hain — strcmp 0 par equal.

topics.title: Assignment aur increment
topics.body: =, +=, -=, *=, /=, %=, &=, |=, ^=, <<=, >>=. Prefix ++i value badhne ke baad deta hai; postfix i++ purani value deta hai. Side effects ka order unspecified ho to UB.

topics.title: Bitwise aur shifts

modules.goal: Stack vs heap, malloc/calloc/realloc/free, leaks, dangling/double free aur ownership.
modules.definition: Dynamic memory runtime par heap se allocate hoti hai: malloc, calloc, realloc aur free. Lifetime programmer ke control me hoti hai.
explain: Stack automatic hai (scope se free), heap manual. malloc bytes leta hai aur uninitialized memory deta hai; calloc count*size leta hai aur zero karta hai; realloc resize karta hai (address badal sakta hai).

Memory leak tab hota hai jab pointer kho jaata hai par memory free nahi hoti. Ownership ka rule likho: kis function ne allocate kiya aur kaun free karega.
sizeof *p pattern use karo: int *p = malloc(n * sizeof *p); type badalne par bhi sahi rehta hai.

modules.definition: File handling se program ka data disk par permanent hota hai. FILE* stream handle hai; fopen mode decide karta hai read/write/append aur text/binary.

Errors: fopen NULL, perror() message, errno code. EOF detection: fgetc == EOF aur feof. Writing ke baad fclose/flush se data disk par jaata hai.
modules.analogy: File ek diary hai: fopen diary kholta hai (mode batata hai padhna ya likhna), fprintf usme likhta hai, fseek kisi page par jaata hai, fclose diary band karta hai.

modules.definition: Preprocessor compile se pehle text transformations karta hai: includes, macros, conditional compilation. Professional C me headers, build automation aur diagnostics ka discipline isi par khada hai.
explain: #define PI 3.14159 object-like macro; #define SQ(x) ((x)*(x)) function-like macro — arguments ko brackets me rakho warna precedence bug. Macro me side effects (SQ(i++)) se bacho.
Header guards (#ifndef X_H / #define / #endif) ya #pragma once double inclusion se bachate hain. Declarations header me, definitions .c me.
Conditional compilation: #ifdef DEBUG, #if, #elif, #else, #endif. Build flags se logging on/off karo.
Command line arguments: int main(int argc, char *argv[]) — argv[0] program name, argc count. atoi/strtol se numbers, validation karo.
GDB: break, run, next, step, print, bt. Sanitizers: -fsanitize=address,undefined. Makefile: targets, dependencies, tabs.
modules.analogy: Preprocessor ek copy editor hai jo compile se pehle text badalta hai; compiler asli grammar baad me dekhta hai. Isliye macro errors weird dikhte hain.
modules.why: Professional projects multi-file hote hain; headers, build flags aur debugger ke bina 10k-line code maintain nahi hota. Interviews me macro pitfalls aur build process poochha jaata hai.

modules.goal: Complexity, linear/binary search, bubble/selection/insertion/merge/quick sort aur two-pointer patterns.
modules.definition: Algorithm problem solve karne ka finite steps ka sequence hai. Complexity batati hai input badhne par time/space kaise badhta hai (Big O).
explain: Big O worst-case growth batata hai: O(1) < O(log n) < O(n) < O(n log n) < O(n^2) < O(2^n). Constants ignore hote hain.
Linear search O(n), binary search O(log n) par sorted array chahiye. Bubble/selection/insertion O(n^2); merge sort O(n log n) stable; quick sort average O(n log n), worst O(n^2).
Two-pointer technique sorted array me pair/sum problems O(n) me solve karta hai; frequency counting hash/array se O(n) deti hai.
Algorithm likhne se pehle pseudocode aur dry run karo — edge cases (empty, one element, duplicates, negative) list karo.
modules.analogy: Algorithm recipe hai aur complexity us recipe ka time estimate. Binary search cookbook me index ki tarah hai — sorted hone par aadha skip ho jaata hai.
modules.why: Interview ka core algorithms aur complexity hai. Sahi algorithm chunna 10x performance deta hai, aur O(n^2) ko O(n log n) me badalna real difference hai.

modules.goal: Linked lists, stack, queue, BST, hash table aur BFS/DFS ko C me implement karna.
modules.definition: Data structure data ko organize karta hai taaki operations efficient hon: linked list O(1) insert/delete, stack LIFO, queue FIFO, BST O(log n) search (balanced), hash table average O(1).
explain: Singly linked list me node {data, next}; head se traverse; insert/delete me pointers update karo aur free karo. Doubly me prev pointer. Circular me tail next head ko.
Stack LIFO hai — push/pop top par; array ya linked list se. Queue FIFO — enqueue rear, dequeue front; circular array se space reuse.
BST me left < root < right; search/insert/delete average O(log n), worst O(n) (skewed). Traversal inorder sorted order deta hai.
Hash table key ko hash function se index me badalta hai; collision ke liye chaining (linked list) ya open addressing. Load factor badhe to resize.
modules.analogy: Linked list ek treasure hunt hai: har clue agle clue ka address deta hai. Array ek shelf hai jahan index se seedha pahunchte ho — insert ke liye shifting chahiye.
modules.why: Ye structures real systems me hain: undo stack, printer queue, database index (B-tree), cache (hash map), graph traversal. Interviews me linked list reverse aur cycle detection classic hain.
